visualCharacteristics: "What's happening in DC" section: a heading with a "More updates" link, a large featured event card with date badge, and a scrolling list of smaller event/news cards with type label and date.
contentPattern: Rows: heading and more link, featured item (date, title, text, image), then one row per list item (type, date, title, link).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for a featured item plus a list of dated events or news.
